name: Acts and Legal Notices of Malta, as published
label: Malta (Acts and Legal Notices)
record_note: The text of every Act (1520) and Legal Notice (14254) on legislation.mt as published, one commit each, dated by its publication day (1964-01-01 to 2026-10-23); not consolidated and not dated by commencement: a law's own commencement, where it states one, is in its Commencement: trailers. The consolidated laws are lexifina/malta-law (mt/national/acts). Data built 2026-10-29.

dates.before_1970: clamped to 1970-01-01, one second apart in order

author.act: the Act or Legal Notice itself
